answer:
Done — I replaced the Lisbon trip packing note’s page with an accessible version for VoiceOver.

It now has:
- Semantic headings and sections
- Native checkboxes with labels
- Keyboard-visible focus states
- VoiceOver-friendly status announcements
- A skip link to “Add an item”
- An accessible form to add new packing items into existing sections

The note’s markdown content was left unchanged; only the page view was updated.
